description:
Request for Quote - N6883626QS0037 0001 for Shear Maintenance in Gulfport, MS.
This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotations are being requested.

Requirement
The Department of the Navy, NAVSUP FLC Jacksonville, requests quotes for Shear Maintenance (AS 500-14) in accordance with the attached Performance Work Statement (PWS). The Government anticipates award of a Firm-Fixed-Price, purchase order.

Primary Location: Gulfport, Mississippi (specific delivery sites will be identified in individual orders)

Submission of Quotes
Due Date/Time: No later than the posted due date on this notice. Late quotes may not be considered. Submission Method: Email to yaynel.c.yambo.civ@us.navy.mil and robert.s.edwards42.civ@us.navy.mil with subject line: “N6883626QS0370001 – Vendor Name”.

Required Quote Contents
1. Company Information: Legal name, UEI, CAGE, business size/status under NAICS 324121, point of contact, email, phone.
2. SIGNED SF-1449 AND SF-30. . 
3. Technical: Follow Technical Volume requirements/instructions in 52.212-1 in the solicitation (page 25 of SF-1449).
4. Pricing: Complete, sign and submit the SF 1449 with a CLIN schedule that includes unit prices (page 3) and extended totals.
5. Certifications: Current SAM registration (or confirmation they are current in SAM).
6. Past Performance (optional but encouraged): Recent, relevant .

Important: Follow all submission and volume/format instructions contained in the attached SF 1449 Solicitation.
